title: Products never ordered
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on products, order_items.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.name

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE order_items (id INT, order_id INT, product_id INT); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'P1'), (2, 'P2'), (3, 'P3'), (4, 'P4'); INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (1, 100, 1), (2, 101, 2), (3, 102, 3);
